qa_pairs.question: What areas should be plug spot welded when working on the front of the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug spot weld front of trunk floor plate, on cross member, side members and wheel houses.

qa_pairs.question: What welding procedure is specified for the cross panel on wheel houses?
qa_pairs.answer: Spot weld cross panel on wheel houses. Spot weld side panels.

qa_pairs.question: What component is shown being welded in figure 30 41 271?
What sealing procedure is required when installing the tail panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Seal off all joints at top and bottom with a body sealing compound.

qa_pairs.question: Where should anti-drumming compound be sprayed during tail panel installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Spray an anti-drumming compound on underside of car, wheel houses and bottom of tail panel.

qa_pairs.question: What is the source reference indicated at the bottom of the page?
What figure number shows the plug spot welding of the trunk floor plate area?
What figure number corresponds to the cross panel spot welding procedure?
What is the complete figure number for the tail panel installation illustration?
What type of compound is specified for sealing joints during tail panel installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Body sealing compound for sealing joints, and anti-drumming compound for spraying on underside areas.

qa_pairs.question: What structural components require spot welding in the trunk floor area?
qa_pairs.answer: Cross member, side members, and wheel houses require spot welding when working on the front of trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What areas need to be treated with anti-drumming compound besides the tail panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Underside of car and wheel houses need to be sprayed with anti-drumming compound in addition to the bottom of tail panel.
